name: graphtraj
description: Task graphs and execution traces for local projects.

interface.shortDescription: Use GraphTraj to plan task dependencies, coordinate execution and follow retained results and traces in a user-owned project.
interface.longDescription: GraphTraj coordinates Agent work in your own project. It tracks which tasks need which results, runs the Agents you configure, and keeps the submitted versions, decisions and execution history together.
defaultPrompt: Use GraphTraj to show which tasks are ready and which are still blocked.
Use GraphTraj to break this goal into tasks with their dependencies, and show me the graph before dispatching anything.
